title: Miura et al. (2009) PNAS 106:11218-11223 & Jaslow (1990) J. Biomech. 23:313-321 Cranial Suture Fractal Interdigitation via Kuramoto-Sivashinsky / KPZ Osteogenic Front Instability

primary_papers.citation: Miura T, Perlyn CA, Kinboshi M, Ogihara N, Morriss-Kay GM (2009) Mechanism of cranial suture fractal interdigitation. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences 106(27):11218-11223
Jaslow CR (1990) Mechanical properties of cranial sutures. Journal of Biomechanics 23(4):313-321

Khonsari RH, Olivier J, Vigneaux P, Sanchez S, Tafforeau P, Ahlberg PE, Di Rocco F, Bresch D, Corre P, Ohazama A, Sharpe PT, Calvez V (2013) A mathematical model for mechanotransduction at the early steps of suture formation. Proceedings of the Royal Society B 280(1759):20122670
Zollikofer CPE, Weissmann JD (2011) A bidirectional interface growth model for cranial interosseous suture morphogenesis. Journal of Anatomy 219(2):100-114

governing_equations.kuramoto_sivashinsky_kpz_interface_pde: dh/dt = -alpha * d^2h/dx^2 - beta * d^4h/dx^4 + (v_0 / 2) * (dh/dx)^2 - gamma * h + eta(x, t)
governing_equations.linear_dispersion_relation: omega(k) = alpha * k^2 - beta * k^4 - gamma
governing_equations.most_unstable_wavenumber: k_max = sqrt(alpha / (2 * beta)),  lambda_max = 2 * pi * sqrt(2 * beta / alpha),  omega_max = alpha^2 / (4 * beta) - gamma
governing_equations.coupled_2d_osteogenic_phase_field: du/dt = D_u * nabla^2 u + a_u * u * (1 - u) * (u - 1/2 + c_0 * v) - b_u * v;  dv/dt = D_v * nabla^2 v + a_v * u - b_v * v
governing_equations.suture_interdigitation_index: SII = L_arc / L_chord = (1 / L) * integral_0^L sqrt(1 + |ds/dl|^2) dl >= 1.0
governing_equations.fractal_box_counting_dimension: N(epsilon) ~ epsilon^(-D_f),  S(k) ~ k^(-(5 - 2 * D_f)),  D_f in [1.0, 1.50]

experimental_regimes.description: Neonatal / infant calvarial suture prior to masticatory and intracranial tensile loading: weak osteogenic front instability produces a nearly smooth linear midline suture with SII ~ 1.05 and box-counting dimension D_f ~ 1.04

Adult Homo sapiens / Mus musculus sagittal suture between paired parietal bones (Miura et al. 2009 Figs. 1-4): BMP4/FGF2 osteogenic front instability balanced by fourth-order surface-tension smoothing and bidirectional overhanging front propagation yields self-affine fractal interdigitation (D_f ~ 1.35, SII ~ 2.75)

Adult lambdoid suture between parietal and occipital bones subjected to high nuchal/masticatory mechanical strain (Jaslow 1990; Miura et al. 2009): elevated osteogenic destabilization alpha = 1.48 and lower fourth-order stiffness beta = 0.52 drive dense multi-scale dendritic interdigitation (D_f ~ 1.41, SII ~ 3.35)

Miura et al. (2009) surgical removal of dura mater / intracranial mechanical unloading control (alpha = -0.35 <= 0): all spatial wavenumbers have negative growth rate omega(k) <= 0, collapsing suture interdigitation to a flat line (D_f -> 1.01, SII -> 1.01)

FGFR2 gain-of-function craniosynostosis (Apert/Crouzon syndrome, Miura et al. 2009; Khonsari et al. 2013): premature osteoblast differentiation across the mesenchymal suture gap eliminates the Twist1/Noggin inhibitory cleft, arresting wavelength selection and fusing the suture into a rigid flat seam (D_f -> 1.00, SII -> 1.00)
